page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Margin notes in the right margin: "Exempla eorum quos Deus tempore famis aluit.", "Moses.", and "Helia.". Running head at top with page number 68. Gathering signature at the foot.

p.i: Matth.6. pluribus prohibet solicitam & anxiam curam de victu & amictu, quin primo & ante omnia quaerentibus regnum Dei haec omnia pollicetur.

Hæ non nudæ sunt promissiones, sed easExempla eorum quos Deus tempore famis aluit. privatis & publicis exemplis illustrauit & confirmauit. Permultos tempore famis mirabiliter aluit, plures etiam malis eripuit. Pauca quædam ex multis audiamus. Mo-Moses.sem quadraginta dies & totidem noctes sine omni cibo & potu, diuina sua virtute in monte Sinai conseruauit. Heliam ad torrentemHelia. Carith, in solitudine ministerio coruorum ma-ne & vespere panes & carnes afferentium aluit. Sic carniuora animalia si necessitas postulat mandante Deo homini seruiunt. Idem ad viduam Sareptanã missus, illa panem quem unicum habebat petenti dedit, eoq; absumpto certam sibi mortem imminere videbat. Is ergo a Domino precibus impetrauit, ut cadus farinæ & olei lecythus nunquam deficeret, quoad fames grauissima quæ triennium integrum durauit, cessauit.

page.notes: The marginal note "Helia." is read as "Helia." but the last letter is partly blotted. The abbreviation after "eo" ("eoq;") is doubtful; it reads as a q with a stroke. Hyphenated words "Mo-sem" and "ma-ne" are split across lines and keep their printed hyphens. The macron over the a in "Sareptanã" is faint. The running head includes the number III as printed. The first paragraph has no indent and continues from the previous page.
